description:
One story over time: its name, where it stands (Now, Peak and Run, 0-1, each with its `basis` and
`known_from`; rising, steady, fading or quiet; whether it moved since `since`), its days in order, each with
its size and its top happening's title, our page and the outlet's link, and its strands. Free. `others` are
the other stories a name found; ask one by its `story`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, such as PL: read from that country in place of the edition's home.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: its days from then, and whether it moved since.

story.description: storyline:N or thread:N, a story's id, or a few words of its name, such as Iran war.

name: story
title: A story over time
